findings.description: Dropped valid usage on refusal, truncation and empty provider envelopes
Malformed JSON/envelope and transport timeout lost observed provider request ID needed by receipt reconciliation
Structured source alias matching upload locator collided and silently omitted selected upload passage
Unowned outbox families before LIMIT starved core dispatch indefinitely
Old stage iteration could authorize a send and commit content during newer iteration
DNS worker thread start failure leaked a bounded DNS permit
Independent audit hard requirement failure disappeared when synthesis omitted that assessment
Late definitive not-sent evidence could not reconcile an already unknown attempt
Nested NaN/Infinity usage metadata could reach PostgreSQL JSON despite valid model content
Journal integrity comparisons accepted bool/float substitutions for integer schema, record sequence and checkpoint sequence
Truthy string final-usage certainty could settle uncertain exposure at zero
Frozen FinishPolicy accepts more protected requests than runtime supports
Invented non-preregistered TrialSpec could authorize an extra paid trial
Altered in-memory manifest could diverge from the approved immutable source artifact while sending
Lowered current operator batch-request cap did not protect remaining mandatory final-role slots
Malformed preregistration human-record shapes escaped sanitized StudyBlocked handling
Negative audit verdict and summary disappeared from blinded reviewer public output
Delayed execute message could finalize a valid retry before admission or finalize a newer generation
Clock regression made active_elapsed and finalize freeze throw the same policy failure, preventing cancellation or terminal partial settlement until time caught up.
findings.fix: Preserve known prior active_seconds; clear unmeasurable interval; persist active_clock_invalid; forbid future remaining-active/retry; dispatcher explicitly finalizes clock-invalid runs without clearing unknown money.
findings.reproduction: All3 new API cancel/advance/dispatcher regression cases failed before the fix.

findings.description: Ambient Decimal precision could round supported1e12 plus18-place token cost down to a budget ceiling, lose fractional finish transfers, break under caller Inexact traps or misreport totals.
findings.fix: Fresh bounded high precision contexts for ledger sums/policy arithmetic, authorization/finish transfers, final accounting and HTTP bounds/costs. Apply matching isolated contexts to experimental replay/admission/authorizations, current study policy and approval reservation arithmetic.
findings.reproduction: Initial suite5 failed/3 passed before context isolation; default-context cap overflow also explicitly asserted with Inexact trap disabled. Experimental direct-library cases initially4 failed/4 passed: precision1 silently changed0.019 hold to0.02 and0.15 exposure to0.1; enabled Inexact traps also broke valid authorization.

weak_existing_assertions.finding: HTTP status/refusal assertions did not check retained usage or request identity; new runtime tests exercise billing failures.
Outbox failure test covered one core item, so unowned-family LIMIT starvation was invisible; new runtime case fills the prefix with unowned work.
Sequential SQLite transaction checks do not establish PostgreSQL concurrent half-open exclusion; test comments already disclose this limit.
Journal corruption cases did not distinguish Python bool/int/float equality; new integrity cases cover each schema/head/record field.
Adapter certainty fixtures did not assert strict final-certainty typing at durable settlement; new experiment cases reject truthiness inputs.

Study tests selected only registered trials and immutable in-memory fixtures; the operator-lock test did not reduce request caps, and public audit fields were not asserted. New paid-boundary tests cover those adversarial inputs.
